استؤذن (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنَ (ustuʔḏina) /us.tuʔ.ði.na/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنَّ (ustuʔḏinna) /us.tuʔ.ðin.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
